case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to alloy and material costs behind your price, and we want to answer that directly. Both cost lines you named have moved the other way recently:

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Against that background, Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this needs a decision on your side beyond your own desk, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides there, so we can settle this quickly between our two family companies.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We would like to build on years of reliable cooperation with a clear, simple solution that works for both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We can accept your requested 45-day payment term and 24-month contract duration. However, for a 24-month term, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to ensure stability for both parties, resulting in a revised price of €5.50 per unit. 

We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices you cited, which allows us to reduce our price. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our current offer is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

None of our options carries one.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.88; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.90; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A up with the colleague who decides on pricing on your side, so that we can close this cleanly. We would like to settle it as a fair solution for both companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our offer of a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

We note your comment regarding our delivery record; however, this does not affect our cost basis for this part. As previously stated, a 24-month contract requires the AS-14404 index clause to ensure stability for both parties. In response to your improved offer, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.40 per unit for a 45-day payment term with the index clause included. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for volume and for an index clause to give both sides stability. Every option below carries a binding annual volume over the full contract term, so your free capacity is filled. None of our options includes an index clause, so the price stays fixed and both of us can plan with it.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.94; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a firm volume for the whole term at a fixed price, and the payment term you already said you can accept.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. It offers a binding volume over the full term, a fixed price and a payment term you have already agreed to, so it can be approved as it stands.

We would like to continue this cooperation between two family-minded companies on a basis that works for both.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
